payload.reason: The evidence discusses various stopping methods evaluated in the context of active learning for text classification, specifically focusing on the impact of batch size and window size on performance.

claims.text: The stopping methods evaluated include the Oracle Method and BV2009, which are used to determine when to stop the active learning process based on model performance metrics.
The performance of stopping methods is affected by batch size, with larger batch sizes leading to degradation in performance compared to smaller batch sizes.
The window size parameter in stopping methods is critical, with smaller window sizes improving performance when larger batch sizes are used.
